AD.summary: Andorra is an EU Annex I listed territory (pets from it enter the EU without a titer test or point-of-entry check). Andorra has no airport, so pets arrive via Spain or France and that country's EU entry rules apply (microchip, rabies vaccination, EU pet passport or EU health certificate; titer test from unlisted countries).

at_a_glance.quarantine: None if EU rules are met

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12 weeks or older)
Primary rabies vaccination becomes valid for travel
EU pet passport (from EU) or EU health certificate and owner declaration
Land in Spain or France; that country's EU entry checks apply

key_points: No airport in Andorra: fly into Spain (e.g. La Seu d'Urgell, Barcelona) or France (e.g. Toulouse)
Unlisted origins need a titer test and 4+ months of lead time
export_points: The EU treats Andorra as listed: pet passport or certificate, no titer, no point-of-entry check

AE.summary: A MOCCAE import permit is required before arrival (valid 90 days), followed by a MOCCAE release permit and inspection at the port of entry. Pets from countries not on MOCCAE's low-risk list (including the USA, Canada, France, Germany and Italy per the official list) also need a rabies antibody titre test of at least 0.5 IU/ml.

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies and core vaccines (rabies at 12 weeks or older)
Titer blood test for high-risk origins such as the US, France, Germany, Italy
Apply online for the MOCCAE import permit (about 1 working day)
Internal and external parasite treatment, recorded on the certificate
Official health certificate endorsed by the origin authority (USDA for US)
MOCCAE release permit and inspection at the port quarantine centre

key_points: Max 2 pets per person per year (returning residents exempt)
Banned dogs and mixes include pit bull types, American Bully, Cane Corso, Bullmastiff, Dogo Argentino
Minimum age 12 weeks (low-risk origin) or 15 weeks (high-risk origin)
Bengal and Serval cats need a fifth-generation pedigree
export_points: MOCCAE export health certificate after a physical inspection; valid 30 days, about 1 working day
Fee AED 100 for 2 pets or fewer
Residents: get the MOCCAE certificate on departure and keep rabies valid until return
AE.private_jet_note: Pets must be listed as manifested cargo and cleared by MOCCAE at an approved airport centre (e.g. DWC, Dubai Cargo Village). Confirm with MOCCAE and the FBO before each flight.

AG.summary: An import license from the Veterinary & Livestock Division is required in advance. The application needs rabies and microchip certification and a FAVN titer result. Pets need parasite treatment within 7 days and an APHIS-endorsed health certificate issued within 7 days before arrival. Pit bulls are banned.

steps.what: Microchip and rabies vaccination
FAVN titer test at an OIE/WOAH-approved lab
Apply for the import license from the Veterinary & Livestock Division
Vet health certificate and parasite treatments, then APHIS endorsement

key_points: Pit bull types and mixes are banned; look-alikes need kennel club certification
Dogs need Ehrlichia and Lyme results; cats need FIP, FeLV and FIV history
No titer waiting period is stated: confirm with the Veterinary & Livestock Division

AI.summary: Get a Government of Anguilla pet import permit and an APHIS-endorsed health certificate valid 14 days. Pets must be 13 weeks or older, ISO-microchipped, rabies-vaccinated at least 30 days before departure, and dewormed after a negative fecal test. Pit bull terriers are prohibited.

steps.what: Rabies vaccination at least 30 days before departure
Apply for the pet import permit via gov.ai
Negative fecal test and internal parasite treatment
Health certificate and tick treatment, then APHIS endorsement

key_points: Pets must be at least 13 weeks old
Pit bull terrier types and other 'ferocious' dogs are prohibited and seized
export_points: A licensed local vet issues the health certificate; the Government Vet endorses it if required

AL.summary: EU-style non-commercial pet certificate issued by the origin country's official/accredited vet. A rabies titer test is needed only if the pet comes from, or transits, a country not on the Annex II list. The APHIS-endorsed certificate must be issued within 10 days of travel.

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12 weeks or older)
Primary rabies vaccination becomes valid for entry
EU-style health certificate, APHIS-endorsed for US pets

key_points: Unlisted origins need a titer and a 3-month wait (4+ months of lead time)
Transit through an unlisted country needs an owner declaration
Unvaccinated young pets: acceptance not guaranteed, confirm in advance

AM.summary: EAEU member with the same rules as Russia. Up to 2 personal dogs/cats may enter on an international passport with rabies and core vaccines and a clinical-exam mark from within 14 days; otherwise an EAEU Form 15 certificate is needed. For US origin, APHIS allows up to 5 pets on Form 15 issued within 5 days of travel.

at_a_glance.permit: Not needed for up to 2 pets

steps.what: Rabies and core vaccines, at least 20 days before travel
Clinical exam marked in the pet passport (up to 2 pets)
Or EAEU Form 15 certificate, APHIS-endorsed (US origin)

key_points: Up to 2 pets on a pet passport; APHIS allows up to 5 on Form 15
Core vaccines must be at least 20 days and at most 12 months old

AO.summary: Angola requires an import permit for pets. A USDA Foreign Agricultural Service report (AO2023-0004, Nov 2023) says Angola's Veterinary Services Institute (ISV) issues 'zoosanitary licenses to import pets', and that ISV accepts health certificates issued by APHIS. Angola does not publish its detailed pet conditions (rabies timing, certificate validity), so get the ISV licence and its written conditions before booking.

steps.what: Request the ISV zoosanitary licence and its written conditions
Vet health certificate and endorsement as ISV instructs
Fly within the licence's 60-day validity with the original on board

key_points: Angola does not publish detailed pet rules: get ISV's written conditions before booking
Licence processing time is unknown; one licence covers a single shipment

AR.summary: Accompanied dogs and cats need an International Veterinary Certificate (CVI) issued or endorsed by the official veterinary authority of the origin country (Mercosur rules), presented to SENASA on arrival. Accompanied pets need no prior import permit.

at_a_glance.microchip: Not required; record on CVI if present

steps.what: Rabies vaccination (a first dose at least 21 days before entry)
Broad-spectrum internal and external parasite treatment
Clinical exam by a registered vet
Official CVI (incl. Spanish) issued or endorsed by the origin authority
SENASA document and identity check

key_points: No breed restrictions for dogs or cats
Unaccompanied cargo pets need a SENASA request 24 business hours ahead and pay a fee
Under 3 months may enter unvaccinated if certified free of rabies exposure
export_points: SENASA issues the CVI: book online up to 30 days ahead with vet certificate and vaccine records
At Ezeiza, documents can be emailed up to 10 days before the flight
Re-entry within 60 days on the SENASA CVI if rabies is still valid

AS.summary: Dog and cat imports to American Samoa are banned by law except: (1) from Hawaii, New Zealand or Australia under Department of Agriculture conditions; (2) from the continental US, Guam or former Trust Territories, but only after mandatory quarantine in Hawaii. EU and other origins are not on the allowed list. Rabies vaccination at least 30 days before arrival. Non-compliant pets are returned at the owner's cost or destroyed.

at_a_glance.quarantine: In Hawaii first if from US mainland

steps.what: Get the Department of Agriculture's entry conditions in writing
US mainland pets: complete Hawaii's import programme and quarantine
Rabies vaccination certified by a government vet

key_points: Imports banned except from Hawaii, NZ or Australia, or US mainland/Guam via Hawaii quarantine
EU and other origins are not on the allowed list
Non-compliant pets are returned at the owner's cost or destroyed
export_points: To New Zealand: Category 2 (rabies-free); the crate needs a vet seal on departure day
AS.private_jet_note: No direct private flight with a pet from the US mainland or Europe: US pets must quarantine in Hawaii first. Get the DOA's conditions in writing before planning.

AT.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: EU passport, or EU certificate ≤10 days (non-EU)

steps.what: ISO microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12+ weeks old)
Primary rabies vaccination becomes valid
From the US: EU health certificate endorsed by USDA APHIS; from the EU: EU pet passport
Carry the signed non-commercial declaration (non-EU origins)
From outside the EU: document and identity check at a travellers' point of entry

key_points: Some Länder (e.g. Vienna) have listed-dog rules: licence, muzzle, leash
Max 5 pets per movement; each travels with the owner or within 5 days
From unlisted countries (e.g. Türkiye, Morocco, Israel, Thailand, South Africa): titer test plus a 3-month wait
Old-model EU certificates are accepted only if issued before 1 Oct 2026
export_points: To EU/EEA countries: EU pet passport from an authorised vet
Dogs going to FI, IE, MT, NO or Northern Ireland also need tapeworm treatment
To non-EU countries: meet destination rules; the official vet service endorses certificates
AT.private_jet_note: From outside the EU, land at a listed point of entry (Vienna, Linz, Klagenfurt, Salzburg, Graz or Innsbruck) for the pet check. Arrange the check with the FBO.

AU.summary: Group 1 (New Zealand, Norfolk Island, Cocos (Keeling) Islands): no quarantine. Group 2 (rabies-free) and Group 3 (approved, rabies absent or well controlled) countries need a DAFF import permit (BICON) and Post Entry Quarantine at Mickleham, arriving into Melbourne. Pets from non-approved countries must first live in an approved country.

at_a_glance.rabies_vaccine: Valid from RNAT draw to export

steps.what: Official vet identity check, then RNAT blood draw
Apply for the DAFF import permit via BICON
Book Post Entry Quarantine at Mickleham
Pre-export tests, parasite treatments and endorsed health certificate
Land in Victoria; the pet goes straight to Mickleham quarantine

key_points: US and most EU pets (Group 3) export only 180+ days after the lab receives the RNAT sample
Identity check before the RNAT cuts quarantine from 30 to 10 days
Banned dogs: pit bull types, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, Tosa, Presa Canario; some cat hybrids
Pets from non-approved countries must first live in an approved country
export_points: Export certification through DAFF; health certificates are government-endorsed
Returning Group 3 pets can use the identity check on their Australian export certificate
AU.private_jet_note: DAFF must approve a private flight before departure via a permit variation. Land at a Victoria first point of entry; the pet stays crated from Australian airspace to Mickleham.

AW.summary: The Aruba Veterinary Service must approve the health certificate and documents BEFORE shipment. Pets need rabies vaccination at least 1 month before travel (if over 3 months old), an AVID/ISO chip, 6 months' residence in the US or Aruba, and a USDA-endorsed certificate issued within 14 days of arrival, with New World screwworm statements.

at_a_glance.microchip: AVID or ISO (else bring a scanner)

steps.what: Rabies vaccination at least 1 month before travel
Health certificate with screwworm statements, USDA-endorsed
Send documents to the Aruba Veterinary Service for approval

key_points: Pet must have lived 6 months in the US or Aruba, unless exempted in writing
Under 3 months: rabies exempt, stated on the certificate
export_points: Back to the US: dogs need a screwworm certificate from an official vet
Aruba is not on the CDC high-risk rabies list

BA.summary: Up to 5 pets with microchip and rabies vaccination. From the EU/EFTA, an EU pet passport is enough. From other countries, an official health certificate valid 10 days is needed, and a titer test is needed if the origin country is not listed. Entry is only through designated traveller entry points.

at_a_glance.titer: Not required from EU or listed origins
at_a_glance.permit: Not needed for up to 5 pets

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12 weeks or older)
Primary rabies vaccination becomes valid
Non-EU: official health certificate; from EU/EFTA: EU pet passport
Enter via a designated traveller entry point for vet checks

key_points: More than 5 pets requires the full import procedure
Non-listed origins need a titer and a 3-month wait (4+ months of lead time)
export_points: To the EU: certificate KZV-EU-11a via a vet registered with the BiH Veterinary Office
New EU certificate rules apply since 22 April 2026
Dogs to FI, IE, MT or NO need tapeworm treatment

BB.summary: Get an import permit first (valid 6 months). Pets need an ISO microchip, rabies vaccination with a 35-day wait after a primary dose, and, if in a Category 2 country within 3 months or arriving by sea, a FAVN. Dogs need heartworm and tick/tapeworm treatment. An officially endorsed certificate within 7 days of travel is required, plus 3 working days' notice. The US is Category 1.

at_a_glance.microchip: ISO, before or with rabies shot

steps.what: Get the import permit from Veterinary Services, Barbados
Microchip and rabies vaccine (35-day wait after a primary dose)
Heartworm test for dogs over 6 months
Vet exam, dog tick and tapeworm treatment, official endorsement
Notify Veterinary Services with owner, broker and flight details

key_points: A customs broker is required
FAVN needed if in a Category 2 country (e.g. UAE) in the last 3 months, or arriving by sea
Arrivals outside Mon–Fri 8:15 am–4:30 pm or on holidays incur overtime fees
BB.private_jet_note: Even cabin pets are treated as cargo and handed to agents for vet and customs clearance via a broker. Give 3 working days' notice and aim for office hours.

BE.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: EU passport, or EU certificate ≤10 days (non-EU)

steps.what: ISO microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12+ weeks old)
Primary rabies vaccination becomes valid
From the US: EU health certificate endorsed by USDA APHIS; from the EU: EU pet passport
Carry the signed non-commercial declaration (non-EU origins)
From outside the EU: document and identity check at a travellers' point of entry

key_points: Max 5 pets per movement; each travels with the owner or within 5 days
From unlisted countries (e.g. Türkiye, Morocco, Israel, Thailand, South Africa): titer test plus a 3-month wait
Old-model EU certificates are accepted only if issued before 1 Oct 2026
export_points: To EU/EEA countries: EU pet passport from an authorised vet
Dogs going to FI, IE, MT, NO or Northern Ireland also need tapeworm treatment
To non-EU countries: meet destination rules; the official vet service endorses certificates
BE.private_jet_note: From outside the EU, land only at an airport on the FASFC point-of-entry list. Confirm the arrival airport with the FASFC before routing.

BF.summary: For US-origin pets (APHIS): USDA-accredited vet issues the bilingual APHIS 'Veterinary Health Certificate for Export of Dogs and Cats to Burkina Faso' (valid 30 days) certifying health and rabies vaccination; USDA original ink endorsement required. French MFA travel advice (updated 15 Sep 2026): dogs and cats need a microchip, an individual passport and an international vaccination booklet, and there is no quarantine in Burkina Faso.

steps.what: Confirm the rabies vaccination is current
Vet exam and bilingual APHIS health certificate
APHIS ink endorsement (allow time for mailing)
Carry the original certificate, pet passport and vaccination booklet

key_points: The original ink-endorsed certificate must travel with the pet

BG.summary: EU rules (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131): from another EU/EEA state, a microchipped pet with a valid rabies vaccination and an EU pet passport; from outside the EU, an EU animal health certificate (plus a rabies titer test with a 3-month wait if the country is not listed) and documentary and identity checks at a travellers' point of entry.

at_a_glance.health_certificate: EU passport, or EU certificate ≤10 days (non-EU)

steps.what: ISO microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12+ weeks old)
Primary rabies vaccination becomes valid
From the US: EU health certificate endorsed by USDA APHIS; from the EU: EU pet passport
Carry the signed non-commercial declaration (non-EU origins)
From outside the EU: document and identity check at a travellers' point of entry

key_points: Max 5 pets per movement; each travels with the owner or within 5 days
From unlisted countries (e.g. Türkiye, Morocco, Israel, Thailand, South Africa): titer test plus a 3-month wait
Old-model EU certificates are accepted only if issued before 1 Oct 2026
export_points: To EU/EEA countries: EU pet passport from an authorised vet
Dogs going to FI, IE, MT, NO or Northern Ireland also need tapeworm treatment
To non-EU countries: meet destination rules; the official vet service endorses certificates
BG.private_jet_note: From outside the EU, land at a pet point of entry (Sofia, Varna, Burgas or Plovdiv) for the checks. Arrange the check with the FBO.

BH.summary: A Bahrain Veterinary Quarantine import permit (Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture) is required. The official USDA–Bahrain certificate requires a microchip, rabies vaccination, a rabies titre of at least 0.5 IU/ml, core vaccines, and a pet aged at least 3 months.

steps.what: Microchip, rabies and core vaccines; rabies booster 2–4 weeks later
Rabies titer test at an accredited lab
Apply for the import permit on services.bahrain.bh
Government-endorsed health certificate

key_points: Pet must be at least 3 months old
From origins other than the US, confirm the conditions with Bahrain Veterinary Quarantine
BH.private_jet_note: Confirm with Bahrain veterinary quarantine and the FBO before the flight how the pet will be cleared on arrival.

BI.summary: Under Burundi's 2009 animal health police law, imported dogs and cats need a health certificate from an official vet in the country of origin, plus an international rabies vaccination certificate dated more than 15 and less than 180 days before import. A mandatory veterinary inspection on arrival happens in daytime only, at designated control posts, and inspection services must be notified at least 24 hours before arrival. Animals arriving without the certificate face a 15-day quarantine at the owner's expense.

steps.what: Rabies booster if the last shot is over ~5 months old (≥15 days before)
Official health certificate and international rabies certificate
Notify Burundi's veterinary inspection services of the arrival
Daytime inspection at an official entry control post

key_points: Rabies certificate must be under 180 days old: 1–3-year vaccines alone are not enough
BI.private_jet_note: Inspection is daytime only at official entry posts with 24 hours' notice. Plan a daytime arrival at Bujumbura and pre-notify the veterinary services.

BJ.summary: Rabies vaccination is mandatory for dogs and cats entering Benin. The vaccination record must show it was given more than one month and less than one year before entry (French Ministry of Foreign Affairs travel advice, updated 15 Sep 2026). Confirm the import permit and health certificate requirements with the Direction de l'Élevage before travel.

steps.what: Confirm with the Direction de l'Élevage whether a permit is needed
Rabies booster if over 1 year old (at least 30 days before arrival)
Vet health certificate, government-endorsed

key_points: A 3-year rabies vaccine given over a year ago does not count: plan a booster

BL.summary: No reliable official information found — check with Elysium Jet operations before booking.
export_points: Pets going to France or the EU that don't meet EU rules need an owner surveillance undertaking (DAAF form)

BM.summary: An import permit (Department of Environment & Natural Resources, Veterinary Services) is needed for each animal. Pets need 2 rabies vaccinations and a licensed-vet health certificate issued within 10 days before arrival. Animals under 10 months, or with only one qualifying rabies vaccine, cannot enter.

steps.what: First rabies vaccine (not before 3 months of age)
Second rabies vaccine, at least 30 days before arrival
Vet exam, tick treatment and health certificate
Vet sends documents to Bermuda Veterinary Services for the permit

key_points: Pets under 10 months or with only one qualifying rabies shot cannot enter
Vaccines must be vet-given; owner or breeder shots are not accepted
Some dog breeds are prohibited or restricted: check gov.bm

BN.summary: A Brunei import permit from the Department of Agriculture and Agrifood is required before shipment, and it sets the conditions for each import. For non-rabies-free origins (CFIA guidance): ISO microchip, rabies vaccination 60 days to 1 year before departure, and a titer of at least 0.5 IU/ml at least 30 days after vaccination. Veterinary inspection on arrival. Non-compliant animals can be held in quarantine for 6 months.

steps.what: Apply for the Brunei import permit (it sets the exact conditions)
Titer blood draw at an approved lab
Vet exam and official export health certificate
Veterinary inspection

key_points: Titer confirmed for Canada and expected for the US: confirm against the permit
Notify transport arrangements and ETA; keep pets isolated during any transit

BO.summary: Dogs and cats need an individual zoosanitary certificate from the origin country's official veterinary authority (in Spanish); SENASAG also lists a Zoosanitary Import Permit (PZI) to be obtained before shipment via VUCE, with final certification on arrival. Official guidance is dated and partly inconsistent — confirm with SENASAG.

steps.what: Confirm with SENASAG whether a PZI import permit is needed
Internal and external parasite treatment
APHIS 7001, endorsed, then legalized at a Bolivian consulate (US)
SENASAG inspection and certification at customs

key_points: Official guidance is dated and partly inconsistent: confirm with SENASAG
EU pet passports are accepted in place of the certificate
export_points: Confirm the export procedure with SENASAG

BQ.summary: Under the Besluit invoer kleine dieren BES (Stb. 2010, 570), dogs and cats need a valid health certificate and valid proof of rabies vaccination. Dogs and cats coming from mainland South or Central America (except Suriname) are banned, unless they belong to someone settling on the islands who has owned them for 4+ months. Confirm certificate timing with the Bonaire veterinary service before travel.

at_a_glance.permit: Not required for your own pet

steps.what: Check the rabies vaccination is valid
Health certificate; confirm timing with the Bonaire veterinary service
Declare the pet to customs

key_points: Pets from mainland South/Central America (not Suriname) banned unless owner settles, 4+ months owned
BQ.private_jet_note: Pets from mainland South/Central America (e.g. via Colombia, Venezuela, Panama) are banned; the operator pays re-shipment and quarantine. Declare the pet at BON.

BR.summary: Dogs and cats need an original International Veterinary Certificate (CVI) on the official model of Portaria MAPA 741/2024 (Mercosur GMC Res. 20/24, mandatory since 06/09/2025) or a valid official passport, issued/endorsed by the origin country's veterinary authority; VIGIAGRO checks on arrival. No import permit for dogs and cats.

steps.what: Rabies vaccination (a first dose at least 21 days before travel)
Broad-spectrum internal and external parasite treatment
Clinical exam by a registered vet
Official CVI on the Mercosur model, issued or endorsed by origin authority
VIGIAGRO check at the point of entry

key_points: Old-format certificates may be refused: use the new Mercosur CVI model
Pets previously diagnosed with leishmaniasis may be refused
Under 90 days may enter unvaccinated if certified free of rabies exposure
export_points: VIGIAGRO issues the CVI free via gov.br; review about 48 h, digitally signed
Re-entry within 60 days on the Brazil-issued CVI if rabies is still valid

BS.summary: Get a BAHFSA veterinary import permit (e-permitting, apply at least 4 weeks ahead) and a USDA-accredited vet export health certificate issued within 10 days of export. Dogs must be 6 months or older, ISO-microchipped before rabies vaccination, and not a banned breed. From 1 Jan 2027, US certificates must be electronically endorsed by APHIS.

steps.what: Check the rabies vaccine falls within the allowed window
Apply for the BAHFSA import permit online
Vet exam, deworming and tick treatment
APHIS endorsement (electronic from 1 Jan 2027)

key_points: Dogs must be 6 months or older
Banned incl. crosses: Pit Bull, Presa Canario, Cane Corso, American Bully, Dogo Argentino, Staffordshire
Rabies: 1-year vaccine ≤10 months old, 3-year vaccine ≤34 months old

BT.summary: Pet imports need a permit from the Bhutan Food and Drug Authority (BFDA) after document verification. Personal pets then do 15 days of quarantine at the owner's home under official monitoring. Confirm the health requirements with BFDA before travel.

steps.what: Contact BFDA and submit health and vaccination documents
BFDA issues the import permit
Land at Paro; 15-day home quarantine under official monitoring

key_points: Paro (PBH) is the only international airport
Confirm all health requirements with BFDA before travel

BW.summary: No dog or cat may enter Botswana except under an import permit from the Director of Veterinary Services (UK official guidance). Pets need rabies vaccination 30 days–12 months before export and an official health certificate (exam within 48 hours). Pets routed via South Africa also need a South African transit permit. The gov.bw service listing says the permit is free and issued in about 1 working day.

steps.what: Apply for the DVS import permit via a District Veterinary Office
Get a South African transit permit
Official health certificate (USDA-endorsed for US pets)

key_points: No dog or cat may enter without an import permit
Routing via South Africa needs a transit permit; a direct flight avoids it
export_points: Namibia accepts Botswana pets with a state-vet certificate and rabies vaccination

BY.summary: EAEU common rules: up to 2 personal dogs/cats with an international pet passport (rabies + core vaccines, clinical exam within 14 days), or an EAEU Form 15 certificate. For US origin, APHIS allows up to 5 pets on a Form 15 certificate issued within 5 days of travel. Flights are heavily restricted by sanctions.

at_a_glance.permit: Not needed for up to 2 pets

steps.what: Rabies and core vaccines, at least 20 days before travel
Clinical exam marked in the pet passport (up to 2 pets)
Or EAEU Form 15 certificate, APHIS-endorsed (US origin)

key_points: Flights are heavily restricted by sanctions: check with Elysium Jet operations
Up to 2 pets on a pet passport; APHIS allows up to 5 on Form 15
Cats on Form 15 are examined for ringworm

BZ.summary: All dogs and cats need a BAHA import permit and a health certificate from a USDA-accredited vet (no APHIS endorsement). Pets under 4 months are home-quarantined until 30 days after their rabies vaccination. Notify BAHA 2 days before arrival; all pets are inspected.

steps.what: Apply for the BAHA import permit
Internal and external parasite treatment (strongly recommended)
Health certificate from a USDA-accredited vet
Notify BAHA of arrival date, time and flight
BAHA inspects every pet; crate must be new or disinfected

key_points: Rabies timing for older pets is set in the permit conditions
Pets under 4 months stay home-quarantined until 30 days after rabies vaccination
export_points: Back to the US: Belize is CDC high-risk; US dogs need USDA-endorsed rabies certification before leaving
Dogs also need a screwworm certificate (official vet inspection within 5 days)
Foreign-vaccinated dogs must arrive at a US airport with a CDC-registered facility

CA.summary: Personal pet dogs (8 months or older) and cats (3 months or older) need a valid rabies vaccination certificate in English or French from a licensed vet; there's no quarantine and no permit. Commercial dogs (resale, adoption, fostering, breeding, show, research) from CFIA's high-risk dog-rabies countries have been banned since 28 Sep 2022, until further notice.

steps.what: Rabies vaccination by a licensed vet
Rabies certificate in English or French that identifies the pet
Present the pet and certificate to CBSA

key_points: Rabies certificate needed from 3 months of age; younger pets exempt
Commercial dogs from CFIA high-risk rabies countries banned since 28 Sep 2022
Unaccompanied dogs under 8 months need a vet certificate issued ≤72 hours before import
No federal breed ban, but provinces may have one (e.g. Ontario's pit bull ban)
export_points: A licensed vet issues the certificate; CFIA endorses it if the destination requires
To the US: CDC Dog Import Form, dog 6 months or older, microchip

CG.summary: Dogs and cats need a recent official health/origin certificate plus a rabies vaccination certificate (Congolese Arrêté of Dec 1968: vaccination more than 1 month and less than 6 months before travel; under-3-month-olds exempt). For US-origin pets (APHIS): bilingual APHIS Congo health certificate valid 30 days, digital USDA endorsement accepted.

steps.what: Rabies vaccine timed to be 1–6 months old at travel
Vet exam and health certificate
Government endorsement (digital USDA endorsement accepted)
Carry the originals, incl. the printed endorsed certificate

key_points: Rabies vaccine must be under 6 months old: most pets need a recent booster
Pets under 3 months are exempt from formalities
Pets with contagious disease or missing documents may be refused entry

CH.summary: EU-equivalent rules: from EU, microchip + valid rabies vaccination + pet passport; from third countries, health certificate (or Swiss/EU passport if already compliant), presentation at the red customs exit, and for rabies high-risk countries a titer test, minimum age 7 months and an FSVO import authorisation for direct flights.

steps.what: Microchip, then rabies vaccine (pet 12 weeks or older)
Rabies vaccination becomes valid
US: health certificate endorsed by USDA; from EU: pet passport
Third-country arrivals: present the pet at the red customs exit

key_points: Dogs with docked ears or tails cannot be imported
High-risk origins: titer, FSVO authorisation, pet 7+ months old, 4+ months of lead time
Max 5 pets unless for registered events
Cantonal breed rules exist: check the destination canton
export_points: The cantonal veterinary service issues export certificates; destination rules apply
Check Swiss re-entry conditions before leaving
CH.private_jet_note: Direct third-country arrivals with pets may only land at Geneva, Zurich or Basel, not Sion, Lugano, Bern or Samedan. Clear there first, then continue.

CI.summary: Dogs and cats need a prior import authorization (import permit) from the Directorate of Veterinary Services (DSV) plus an official health certificate issued close to travel, with current rabies vaccination. For US-origin pets (APHIS): certificate endorsed by APHIS within 10 days of travel.

SB.summary: Solomon Islands needs an import permit, a statutory declaration and a government vet health certificate. Dogs and cats must be desexed. Four dog types are banned, and there is no quarantine facility on the island.

Dog blood tests, 2 faecal tests 14 days apart and 2 dewormings

From countries not free of rabies (including the USA), a titer test of at least 0.5 IU/ml done 3–12 months before shipment is required. Arrival must be notified 48 h ahead, followed by 2 weeks' isolation. The official document covers cats only, so confirm dog conditions with LVV.

UY.summary: Dogs and cats need a CVI (Mercosur model) or validated official passport from the origin country's veterinary authority; dogs additionally need an ISO microchip, praziquantel deworming and (from non-free countries) a negative leishmaniasis test within 60 days. No MGAP entry authorization if travelling with the pet; no fee.

VA.summary: Vatican City is an EU Annex I listed territory (pets from it enter the EU without a titer test or point-of-entry check). Vatican City has no airport, so pets arrive via Italy (Rome) and that country's EU entry rules apply (microchip, rabies vaccination, EU pet passport or EU health certificate; titer test from unlisted countries).

Pets need a microchip before rabies vaccination, US residence for 6 months, vaccines, a heartworm test and parasite treatment within 7 days, an APHIS-endorsed certificate (original ink), and 48 hours' notice.

VI.summary: From the US or Puerto Rico: no permit (interstate), but a health certificate by an accredited vet within 10 days of arrival, current rabies vaccination, and an emailed certificate at least 1 business day before arrival are needed. From abroad: USVI rules plus federal CDC/USDA rules.

VN.summary: Vietnam needs a health certificate from the exporting country (for US pets: a USDA-endorsed, Vietnam-specific certificate stating current rabies vaccination, valid 30 days). No titer and no routine quarantine.

VU.summary: Biosecurity Vanuatu import permit required, using the health certificate attached to the permit (new conditions since 30 May 2024). Per Australian MICoR guidance, dogs must arrive by air as manifested cargo. Transit or offloading is allowed only in Australia, New Zealand or New Caledonia, and flight details must reach the Principal Veterinary Officer at least 1 working day before. Pregnant or nursing females and pups under 16 weeks are not eligible. Direct private-jet arrival from the US or EU is not compatible with these rules.

Pets from metropolitan France must first do quarantine in New Caledonia. Category 1 and 2 dogs (Pit Bull, Mastiff, Tosa, American Staffordshire, Rottweiler types) are banned from transport. US/EU pets cannot fly direct to Wallis.

WS.summary: Samoa import permit (Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries) required, and dogs are subject to quarantine inspection on arrival. Conditions for US/EU origin are not published.

XK.summary: Kosovo's Administrative Instruction 02/2009 on non-commercial movement of pets (still published by the Food and Veterinary Agency) mirrors the old EU pet scheme. Pets from EU/listed countries, including the USA, need an ISO microchip, valid rabies vaccination and a passport or veterinary certificate. Pets from unlisted countries also need a rabies titer (≥0.5 IU/ml, ≥30 days after vaccination and 3 months before entry) and echinococcus treatment. IATA Timatic adds a ≥30-day wait after rabies vaccination and echinococcus treatment for dogs and cats.

YT.summary: Mayotte is a French department in the EU, so EU pet rules under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/131 apply, as confirmed by DAAF de Mayotte. From mainland France or the overseas departments, a microchip and EU pet passport are enough; from another EU state, the pet also needs a valid rabies vaccination. From outside the EU (including the USA), the pet needs a microchip, valid rabies vaccination and an EU animal health certificate, plus a rabies titer unless the country is EU-listed (the USA is listed). Category 1 'attack' dogs are banned, and category 2 dogs need prefectoral authorisation.

Pets must arrive as manifested cargo at an airport with state veterinary inspection (Johannesburg O.R. Tambo, Cape Town, Durban King Shaka). Dogs need a series of pre-import blood tests.
